title: Dynamic networks of PTSD symptoms during conflict
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Sample limited to civilians exposed to rocket fire; - Data collected during conflict, not post-conflict; - Methodological limitations with multilevel network analysis (no fit statistics, assumes stationarity); - Limited power to include covariates.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. The authors mention using the mlVAR package in R for estimation and qgraph for visualization, but do not specify the exact versions for visualization. The code and data are available upon request, as stated in the paper.
